remediation_details.remediation: Group related parameters into a single object
remediation_details.best_practice_explanation: Grouping related parameters into a single object improves code readability and maintainability by reducing the number of method parameters, making it easier to modify or extend the method in the future.

remediation_details.remediation: Extract a helper method to reduce nesting
remediation_details.best_practice_explanation: Reducing deep nesting improves code readability and maintainability by breaking down complex logic into smaller, more manageable pieces.

remediation_details.remediation: Split the class into separate classes for order processing and helper methods
remediation_details.best_practice_explanation: Splitting the class into separate classes for order processing and helper methods improves maintainability, readability, and follows the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP), which states that a class should have only one reason to change.
